description: A blond-haired man whose goal is to eliminate all humans, as he can no longer trust them due to their cruelty and lack of self-control.His desire to kill anyone he comes across directly contradicts his twin brother's pacifist ideal of respecting every form of life, especially the weak. Even so, Knives attempts to persuade Vash into joining his cause several times by demonstrating the wicked nature of humanity.Vash rejected Knives' violent ways, and thus the latter organized a plan to punish his brother for spurning him. A superb gunfighter, Knives is ready for the day when he will finally teach Vash the lesson of a lifetime...
summon: Why grow up if you only grow more sentimental?
fusion: Wanting to save both spiders and butterflies is a contradiction.
evolution: Now, let's dispose of all the trash.
